zh: 删除若干元素后剩下的就是原数组的一个非空子序列；一个被保留的元素能否得分，只取决于它前面保留了多少个元素。
按原顺序处理元素，用 dp[k] 表示在已处理的前缀中保留 k 个元素时能得到的最大 beauty。保留当前元素 x 会让长度从 k 变成 k+1，并且当 x 恰好等于 k+1 时多得 1 分。
dp[0]=0，其余初始化为不可达；对每个元素，让 k 从大到小枚举，用 dp[k] 加上（x 等于 k+1 时为 1，否则为 0）去更新 dp[k+1]，倒序保证同一个元素不会被用两次；全部处理完后在长度 1..n 中取 dp 的最大值，因为数组至少要保留一个元素。
en: After deletions what remains is a non-empty subsequence of the original array; whether a kept element scores depends only on how many elements are kept before it.

Process elements in order and let dp[k] be the best beauty when k elements of the processed prefix are kept. Keeping the current element x moves the length from k to k+1 and scores one more point exactly when x equals k+1.

Set dp[0] = 0 and everything else unreachable; for each element, loop k from high to low and relax dp[k+1] with dp[k] plus 1 if x equals k+1 (otherwise plus 0); the reverse order ensures an element is used at most once. At the end take the maximum of dp over lengths 1..n, because at least one element must remain.

explanationEn:
## Approach

The DP state dp[k] is the maximum beauty when a subsequence of length k is chosen from the current prefix. When the current element is kept, its new position is k+1, which decides whether it scores; update in reverse order to avoid choosing it more than once.

## Proof of correctness

dp[k] is the maximum beauty achievable after processing the current prefix of the original array and choosing a subsequence of length k. Skipping the current element keeps the old state; choosing it puts it at new position k+1, and it scores only when its value is exactly k+1. Reverse-order transitions guarantee that each original element is used at most once. After processing everything, take the maximum over all non-empty lengths.

## Complexity

O(n^2), space O(n).
